title: Transfer files with SFTP
summary: Copy files between your local computer and a remote server while inside an active SFTP session. Use 'get' to download and 'put' to upload.

steps.explain: Inside the SFTP interactive prompt, use 'get' to download a file from the remote server to your current local directory.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file on the remote server

alternatives.explain: Use 'get -R' to download an entire directory recursively.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory on the remote server

steps.explain: Inside the SFTP interactive prompt, use 'put' to upload a file from your current local directory to the remote server.

placeholders.name: LOCAL_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file on your local computer
